This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [https://www.dgepress.com/ Disney General Entertainment Press].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article. Fill in the required fields plus as many of the optional fields as necessary and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{DisneyPress|subdomain=|domain=|url=|text=|author=|date=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=|oldversion=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>http://www.disney.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|abc}} changes the domain to disneyabcpress.com
*{{Para|subdomain}} The subdomain part of the web page's URL, for example, <code>books</code> or <code>blogs</code>. (Defaults to <code>www</code> if not specified).
*{{Para|domain}} When citing from an international Disney website such as <code><nowiki>https://disney.co.uk/</nowiki></code>. (Defaults to <code>.com</code> if not specified).
*{{Para|author}} Name(s) of the author(s). Multiple authors must be separated with a "<code>;</code>" between their names. Note that an author is not necessarily an individual and could be an organization. A long list of authors can be reduced using "<code>, et al.</code>" after the first name. Provide wikilinks whenever they are available.
*{{Para|date}} Full date of publication, in [[Wikipedia:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format, for example "<code>date=2006-02-17</code>".
*{{Para|oldversion}} use <code>|oldversion=1</code> when the current version of the web page no longer includes the target information.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
;Using subdomain
<code><nowiki>{{DisneyPress|url=disneyxd/shows/lego-star-wars-the-freemaker-adventures/episodes|text=LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{DisneyPress|url=disneyxd/shows/lego-star-wars-the-freemaker-adventures/episodes|text=LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures}}
